system_name: University Campus Student Portal & Grade Registry

components.name: Student Web & Mobile Browser
components.description: Student endpoints accessing course registration, exam timetables, and grades.

components.name: Faculty Portal Workstation
components.description: Instructor devices submitting grades, assignments, and curriculum updates.

components.name: Campus Ingress API Gateway
components.description: Reverse proxy routing student and faculty requests, terminating TLS.

components.name: Student Record Microservice
components.description: Internal business logic handling course enrollment, degree progression, and GPAs.

components.name: PostgreSQL Gradebook Database
components.description: Relational database holding student grades, transcripts, and financial status.

components.name: HTTPS Student Ingress Flow
components.description: REST API traffic containing user credentials, course drop/add commands.

components.name: Internal Service-to-Database SQL Flow
components.description: Database query flow transmitting grade modification queries and student transcript data.

threats.title: Credential Stuffing or Session Hijacking
threats.description: An adversary impersonates a legitimate user using stolen credentials or hijacked session cookies.
threats.impact: Unauthorized access to student academic records and portal actions.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Enforce MFA/FIDO2, short-lived signed session tokens, and IP/device posture binding.

threats.title: Unauthenticated Action Repudiation
threats.description: A user performs high-risk transactions (e.g. course drops, grade edits) and later denies having initiated them.
threats.impact: Inability to maintain non-repudiation in audit investigations.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Immutable audit logging, cryptographic digital signatures, and forward-secure log shipping.

threats.title: Service Identity Impersonation
threats.description: Rogue microservice impersonates a trusted backend API worker.
threats.impact: Attacker intercepts inter-service RPCs and poisons internal message queues.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Deploy mTLS (Mutual TLS) with SPIFFE/SPIRE or Cloudflare Zero Trust service tokens.

threats.title: Memory or Parameter Tampering (Injection Attacks)
threats.description: Malicious payload manipulates backend execution flow via SQLi, command injection, or deserialization.
threats.impact: Remote code execution or arbitrary backend database manipulation.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Strict input validation, parameterized queries, and least-privilege service containers.

threats.title: Log Injection or Log Deletion
threats.description: Adversary alters local execution logs or floods log storage to obfuscate unauthorized changes.
threats.impact: Failure of compliance audits and lost forensic traceability.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Centralized write-once log aggregation with cryptographic log hashing.

threats.title: Verbose Error Leaks or Memory Exposure
threats.description: Application crashes leak stack traces, environment variables, or database connection strings.
threats.impact: Attacker acquires reconnaissance details to pivot into deeper network segments.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Sanitized error handling, custom generic 500 error pages, and secret management tools (Vault).

threats.title: Resource Starvation / ReDoS / Algorithmic Complexity Attack
threats.description: Excessive or computationally asymmetric requests exhaust CPU, memory, or thread pools.
threats.impact: Service outage during high-traffic windows (e.g. course registration rush).
threats.recommended_mitigation: Cloudflare DDoS protection, rate limiting, connection pooling, and circuit breakers.

threats.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR)
threats.description: Standard student account accesses administrator endpoints by manipulating record IDs.
threats.impact: Privilege escalation leading to unauthorized grade modifications or administrative takeover.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Enforce RBAC/ABAC authorization checks on every data access query.

threats.title: Unauthorized Direct Database Modification
threats.description: Attacker accesses database port directly to alter grade or financial ledgers.
threats.impact: Data corruption and academic record integrity compromise.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Restrict network access via Cloudflare Tunnels (no exposed public IPs), encrypt at rest.

threats.title: Unlogged Administrative Modifications
threats.description: DBA or compromised root account updates database tables directly without logging.
threats.impact: Undetectable modification of sensitive records.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Enable database-level audit triggers and append-only write logs.

threats.title: Data Breach via Backup Exposure or Unencrypted Disk
threats.description: Unencrypted backups or unsegmented storage buckets leak student PII and grades.
threats.impact: Mass confidentiality breach, FERPA compliance violation.
threats.recommended_mitigation: AES-256 database-level column encryption, IAM access controls, and strict DLP.

threats.title: Storage Exhaustion or Connection Pool Locking
threats.description: Unbounded table growth or deadlocks lock database read/write queries.
threats.impact: System-wide failure and transaction failures.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Disk quotas, query timeout limits, connection pool pooling (PgBouncer), and read replicas.

threats.title: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) Packet Modification
threats.description: Adversary alters unencrypted or weak cipher packets in transit over campus Wi-Fi.
threats.impact: Manipulation of student submissions or financial payment parameters.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Enforce TLS 1.3 with HSTS and Certificate Pinning.

threats.title: Traffic Eavesdropping / Packet Sniffing
threats.description: Unencrypted plaintext HTTP traffic captured over rogue campus access points.
threats.impact: Session token and password theft.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Zero Trust network policy, WARP client encryption, and mandatory HTTPS.

threats.title: SYN Flood / Network Pipe Saturation
threats.description: Volumetric attack saturates campus ingress bandwidth.
threats.impact: Inability for legitimate users to access on-campus hosted portals.
threats.recommended_mitigation: Cloudflare Magic Transit and Anycast DDoS mitigation edge.
